❌ Legacy Single-Port First-Byte Demux Failures (RFC 9443 / 7983)
1. TURN vs. QUIC Short-Header Collision: QUIC 01xxxxxx (Byte 0 64..127)
overlaps TURN ChannelData 0x4000-0x4FFF (64..79), corrupting Opus audio.
2. Naive byte0 > 127 RTP Fallthrough: Admitting Byte 0 192..255 (RTP v=3)
into SRTP decryptors triggers auth-failure storms and ROC desync.
3. Unallocated Byte-0 Log/Error Amplification: Flooding Byte 0 ∈ [4, 15]
triggers DTLS alerts and 500+ logs/s disk I/O starvation on media workers.
Result: TURN/QUIC audio corruption + SRTP/DTLS exception log storm
✅ Deterministic P1009–P1010 🎉 (150th FAQ & 950 Tests!) Demux Gate
1. P1009 (1,018th Guard) 256-Slot Disjoint LUT: Isolate STUN(0..3),
2. P1010 🎉 (🎉 150th FAQ, P1010 & 950th Test) Silent Drop & Log Cap:
Silently drop unallocated Byte 0 in 0ms & clamp logs ∈ [1, 10] logs/s.
3. Zero Reflection Amplification: Never emit STUN/DTLS/ICMP error packets
in response to unauthenticated unknown-first-byte UDP probes.
Result: 0 Byte-0 demux collisions · 0 parser leaks · logs ∈ [1, 10]/s
